page.overview:
Who is Gary's mother?

On October 31, 1978, Gary's mother had to take him to Haddonfield Memorial Hospital after he had bitten into a razor blade that was planted inside of a piece of candy.

They were able to leave shortly afterwards and avoided the terror that would happen at the same hospital later in the night. Category:Halloween II (1981) characters Category:Female characters Category:Minor characters Category:Mothers Category:Unnamed characters
